Crisis Care & Lifelines

If you or someone you care about is carrying overwhelming weight, please do not navigate it alone. Vetted, compassionate humans are standing by right now.

24/7 CALL & TEXT USA & Canada

988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline

Free, confidential support for people experiencing suicidal ideation, severe emotional distress, panic attacks, or substance use concerns.

Call 988 (Toll-Free) Text 988
SMS TEXT 24/7 US, UK & Canada

Crisis Text Line

Connect quietly via SMS with a trained volunteer crisis counselor anytime day or night. Ideal if you cannot talk aloud safely.

Text HOME to 741741 Web Chat
LGBTQ+ YOUTH North America

The Trevor Project

24/7 confidential suicide prevention and affirming crisis intervention services for LGBTQ young people.

Call 1-866-488-7386 Text START to 678678

STUDIO READING LIST

Vetted Bibliotherapy

Books Maya and Marcus recommend to every listener seeking deep, enduring healing.

TRAUMA & SOMATICS

The Body Keeps the Score

by Bessel van der Kolk, M.D.

The definitive medical and psychological exploration of how traumatic stress physically alters the brain, heart, and immune system, with somatic paths to renewal.

Marcus's #1 Clinical Must-Read
BEREAVEMENT

It's OK That You're Not OK

by Megan Devine

Meeting grief and loss in a culture that doesn't understand. A furious, tender dismantling of standard grief platitudes.

Maya's Hand-Gifted Choice
HUMAN CONDITION

Maybe You Should Talk to Someone

by Lori Gottlieb

A therapist, her therapist, and our lives revealed. Hilarious, compassionate, and deeply humanizing look behind clinical walls.

Community Favorite
EMOTIONAL VOCABULARY

Atlas of the Heart

by Brené Brown, Ph.D.

Mapping eighty-seven of the emotions and experiences that define what it means to be human. Precision language for what we feel.

Essential Lexicon
SOMATIC HEALING

My Grandmother's Hands

by Resmaa Menakem, MSW, LICSW

Racialized trauma and the pathway to mending our hearts and bodies. Groundbreaking body-centered racial healing.

Host Recommendation
MINDFUL PRESENCE

When Things Fall Apart

by Pema Chödrön

Heart advice for difficult times. How to lean into painful moments and lean into groundlessness without terror.
